models.description: KSP AI Copilot RAG model over the official FIR ERD and CIAP intelligence findings
models.system_prompt: You are KSP Intelligence Copilot, an AI assistant for Karnataka State Police. Respond ONLY in {language}. Be professional, concise, factual, and cite CaseMaster or IntelligenceFinding records when available. Never fabricate crime statistics.

models.description: Crime count forecasting model using historical CaseMaster FIR data

training_data_source.query: SELECT DATE(cm.CrimeRegisteredDate) AS date, u.DistrictID, ch.CrimeGroupName, COUNT(*) AS incident_count FROM CaseMaster cm LEFT JOIN Unit u ON cm.PoliceStationID = u.UnitID LEFT JOIN CrimeHead ch ON cm.CrimeMajorHeadID = ch.CrimeHeadID GROUP BY DATE(cm.CrimeRegisteredDate), u.DistrictID, ch.CrimeGroupName
